verdict.rationale: Shopify's POS features page documents Sidekick, Shopify's AI assistant, generating reordering suggestions from sales velocity and seasonality. It can also recommend stock transfers between locations from performance trends and create them automatically, so the core of AI-generated insights from the merchant's own data is delivered. missing for 10: in-depth first-party documentation beyond marketing one-liners, evidence of AI insights beyond inventory (e.g. sales or customer analytics), clarity on whether Sidekick runs inside the POS app itself versus Shopify admin, independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product

citations.quote: Use Sidekick, Shopify’s AI assistant, to get reordering suggestions based on sales velocity and seasonality.
Ask Sidekick to recommend stock transfers between locations based on performance trends, and create them for you automatically.
